(a) Fenske equation:
N_min = ln[(0.95/0.05)(0.95/0.05)] / ln(2.5)
= ln(361) / ln(2.5) = 5.889 / 0.9163 = 6.43 stages

(b) Underwood equations, saturated liquid (q = 1):
2.5(0.40)/(2.5-theta) + 0.60/(1-theta) = 0, theta = Underwood root
1/(2.5-theta) = 0.60/(theta-1), so theta = 1.5625
R_min+1 = 2.5(0.95)/(2.5-1.5625) + 0.05/(1-1.5625)
= 2.533 - 0.089 = 2.444, so R_min = 1.44

FINAL (a): 6.43 stages
FINAL (b): 1.44 dimensionless
